document_name: Speed WMS Base Data Tables — Warehouse Mapping & Master Data

core_tables.TIE_PAR: Third parties — suppliers, carriers, recipients, contacts

columns.name: EMP_LIEU
columns.description: Location code — unique identifier for each physical storage position

columns.name: GAB_CODE
columns.description: Template/gabari code — defines the physical size and type of the location

ZEM_BAS.description: Warehouse zones — logical groupings of locations

EMZ_DAT.description: Assignment table linking locations to zones

TIE_PAR.description: Third parties master — suppliers, carriers, recipients, contacts

columns.name: TTI_CODE
columns.description: Third party type code — see reference_codes for values

STK_DAT.description: Current stock — one record per stock unit

columns.name: STK_KEYU
columns.description: Surrogate unique key for stock record

MVT_DAT.description: All stock movements — inbound, outbound, transfers

columns.name: TMV_CODE
columns.description: Movement type code — see reference_codes for values

locations_to_zones.description: Get all locations with their zone assignments
locations_to_zones.example_sql: SELECT emp.EMP_LIEU, zem.ZEM_CODE FROM EMP_BAS emp INNER JOIN EMZ_DAT emz ON emz.EMP_LIEU = emp.EMP_LIEU INNER JOIN ZEM_BAS zem ON zem.ZEM_CODE = emz.ZEM_CODE WHERE emp.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE

article_to_dimensions.description: Get article with its physical dimensions
article_to_dimensions.example_sql: SELECT art.ART_CODE, art.ART_DESL, dim.DIM_TYPE, dim.DIM_VL FROM ART_PAR art INNER JOIN DIM_DAT dim ON art.ACT_CODE = dim.ACT_CODE AND art.ART_CODE = dim.ART_CODE WHERE art.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE

article_to_identifiers.description: Get article with all its identifiers/barcodes
article_to_identifiers.example_sql: SELECT art.ART_CODE, art.ART_DESL, ide.IDE_IDENT FROM ART_PAR art INNER JOIN IDE_DAT ide ON art.ACT_CODE = ide.ACT_CODE AND art.ART_CODE = ide.ART_CODE WHERE art.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE

article_to_suppliers.description: Get article with its supplier relationships
article_to_suppliers.example_sql: SELECT art.ART_CODE, art.ART_DESL, tie.TIE_CODE FROM ART_PAR art INNER JOIN AMT_DAT amt ON art.ACT_CODE = amt.ACT_CODE AND art.ART_CODE = amt.ART_CODE INNER JOIN TIE_PAR tie ON amt.ACT_CODE = tie.ACT_CODE AND amt.TIE_CODE = tie.TIE_CODE WHERE art.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE

article_to_picking_locations.example_sql: SELECT art.ART_CODE, pik.EMP_LIEU, pik.ZEM_CODE FROM ART_PAR art INNER JOIN PIK_BAS pik ON art.ACT_CODE = pik.ACT_CODE AND art.ART_CODE = pik.ART_CODE WHERE art.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE AND art.ART_CODE = :ART_CODE

article_to_alcohol_data.example_sql: SELECT art.ART_CODE, art.ART_DESL, alc.ALC_FIS FROM ART_PAR art INNER JOIN ALC_ART alc ON art.ACT_CODE = alc.ACT_CODE AND art.ART_CODE = alc.ART_CODE WHERE art.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE

stock_with_article_and_location.description: Get current stock with article details and location
stock_with_article_and_location.example_sql: SELECT stk.STK_KEYU, art.ART_CODE, art.ART_DESL, stk.EMP_LIEU FROM STK_DAT stk INNER JOIN ART_PAR art ON stk.ACT_CODE = art.ACT_CODE AND stk.ART_CODE = art.ART_CODE INNER JOIN EMP_BAS emp ON stk.EMP_LIEU = emp.EMP_LIEU WHERE stk.ACT_CODE = :ACT_CODE

TMV_CODE_inbound.description: Movement type codes for inbound stock creation

TMV_CODE_outbound.description: Movement type codes for outbound stock exit

safety_rules: Always filter by ACT_CODE on every table access
EMP_BAS primary access key is EMP_LIEU — not a composite key
GAB_PAR primary access key is GAB_CODE
ZEM_BAS primary access key is ZEM_CODE
TIE_PAR access requires ACT_CODE + TIE_CODE pair
ART_PAR access requires ACT_CODE + ART_CODE pair
